request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and intimate, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, muted trumpet, saxophone, smooth jazz mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The line goes back through years unknown
From Levi's name to Jannai's throne
Joseph is the fifth in the row
A thread that only God knows

[Pre-Chorus]
Between the ages, waiting still
His place is listed, quiet, mild
In the book of Luke's record
His name is held with sacred accord

[Chorus]
He is the son of Matthat
The son of Levi, that is that
In the chain from David's day
The promise held in ordinary way

[Verse]
Amos follows, then Nahum
Esli and Naggai come with him
Maath and Semein stand by
Josech and Joda, under the sky

[Pre-Chorus]
Joanan and Rhesa appear
Zerubbabel is there
Shealtiel and Neri follow close
Melchi and Addi, lost in the prose

[Chorus]
He is the son of Matthat
The son of Levi, that is that
In the chain from David's day
The promise held in ordinary way

[Verse]
Cosam and Elmadam stand
Er and Joshua, as required by hand
Eliezer and Jorim near
Matthat again, Levi is dear

[Pre-Chorus]
Simeon and Judah are named
Joseph and Jonam, in the game
Eliakim and Melea seen
Menna and Mattatha, the ancient dream

[Chorus]
He is the son of Matthat
The son of Levi, that is that
In the chain from David's day
The promise held in ordinary way

[Bridge]
Nathan and David end the list
A faithful link, a holy gist
From Adam down to Jesus' face
God kept the promise in time and space

[Outro]
The son of Matthat
Remembered in the chain of days
